subject: [RFC PATCH 48/57] mm/collapse: assert the mm reference the engine relies on

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the collapse engine in the Linux kernel to assert that a reference to the mm_struct exists before performing certain operations. The patch addresses a bug where the engine was checking if the mm_users count had reached zero, which is not possible due to the way callers hold references on mm_users. Instead, it checks if collapsing has been disabled by prctl and asserts that a reference exists in other cases. This change ensures that a caller with no reference on mm_users will be detected as an error in debug builds.
